newsitem.title: USA: ADT on target for 1996 residential sales.
newsitem.headline: ADT on target for 1996 residential sales.

text.p: ADT Ltd, the largest electronic security company in North America, said it expects to sell 250,000 residential security systems this year.
"We're well on our way," said Steve Ruzika, president of the company's electronic security services division.
The company sold 215,000 units last year.
Ruzika made his comments at a two-day conference about mergers and acquisitions in the security industry. It was sponsored by several organizations, including Lehman Brothers.
He declined to discuss the company's proposed acquisition by Republic Industries Inc.

Originally valued at $5 billion when it was announced in July, the value of the proposed transaction has declined due to stock volatility. Wall Street experts anticipate that terms of the deal may have to be revised before it is consummated.
